newsitem.title: UK: UK publishes late payment interest plans for firms.
newsitem.headline: UK publishes late payment interest plans for firms.

text.p: The government on Monday published a consultative Green Paper on its proposals to give companies the statutory right to charge interest on business customers who pay late for goods or services.

Small businesses minister Barbara Roche said she believed that legislation should initially give small firms the right to make claims against larger companies and public bodies. But similar rights should then be extended to all companies.

"The Government recognises that small businesses, with their more limited resources, must be given time to benefit from being paid promptly by their large creditors and to take the necessary actions to ensure that they have the systems in place to make payments on time," Roche said.
Interested parties have been asked to comment on the government's plans by October 3.
The government said in the Queen's Speech setting out its legislative plans for the current session of parliament, that it planned legislation to help small businesses with late payment problems.
